Wizard.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, max 1 MB
Wizard.logoTooBig: Logo must be 1 MB or smaller.
Wizard.revenueIntro: We only accept a Stripe restricted key with read access. It's encrypted, never shown again, and you can revoke it in Stripe any time.
Wizard.howTo1: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys → Create restricted key
Wizard.howTo2: Set Charges → Read and Subscriptions → Read. Leave everything else as None.
Wizard.howTo3: Create the key, copy it (starts with rk_live_) and paste it below.
Wizard.noStripe: Not using Stripe? You can list now as unverified and connect later.
Wizard.limitReached: You can list up to 5 startups.

Errors.rate_limited: Stripe is rate-limiting us — try again in a minute.
Errors.upstream: Stripe didn't respond as expected. Try again shortly.
Errors.cooldown: Refreshed recently — try again in a few minutes.
